# 3D Secure test scenarios

In the PayPal sandbox, you can use test cards to simulate various payment scenarios and generate a 3D Secure response. This page includes test cards for both purchase flows and save payment method flows.

**Tip:** Enter a future expiration date and any 3-digit CVV (or 4-digit for American Express) to proceed.

---

## Test cases and card details for purchase flows

Use these cards to simulate a purchase and generate a 3D Secure response. **Do not** use these for Save payment methods testing.

Countries covered: United States, Great Britain, China, Australia, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Mexico, Spain.

### 9 Standard Test Scenarios (all countries)

| Test Case | Scenario | enrollment_status | authentication_status | liability_shift |
| --------- | -------- | ----------------- | --------------------- | --------------- |
| 1 | Successful Frictionless Authentication | Y | Y | POSSIBLE |
| 2 | Failed Frictionless Authentication | Y | N | NO |
| 3 | Attempts Stand-In Frictionless Authentication | Y | A | POSSIBLE |
| 4 | Unavailable Frictionless Authentication | Y | U | NO |
| 5 | Rejected Frictionless Authentication | Y | R | NO |
| 6 | Authentication Not Available on Lookup | U | — | NO |
| 7 | Successful Step-up Authentication | Y | Y | POSSIBLE |
| 8 | Failed Step-Up Authentication | Y | N | NO |
| 9 | Step-Up Authentication is Unavailable | Y | U | NO |

## Test cases and card details for Save payment methods

Use these cards for Payment Method Tokens v3 API testing. **Do not** use for purchase flows.

**Important:** Expiration year = current year + 3. Expiration month always = 01.

Cards available: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, ELO.

| Test Case | Scenario | API response |
| --------- | -------- | ------------ |
| 1 | Successful No-Challenge Authentication | authenticate_successful |
| 2 | Failed No-Challenge Authentication | authenticate_frictionless_failed |
| 3 | Attempt No-Challenge Authentication | authenticate_attempt_successful |
| 4 | Unavailable No-Challenge Authentication from Issuer | authenticate_unable_to_authenticate |
| 5 | Rejected No-Challenge Authentication by Issuer | authenticate_rejected |
| 6 | Authentication Not Available on Lookup | authentication_unavailable |
| 7 | Error on Lookup | lookup_error |
| 8 | Timeout on Lookup | lookup_failed_acs_error |
| 9 | Bypassed Authentication | lookup_bypassed |
| 10 | Successful Challenge Authentication | authenticate_successful |
| 11 | Failed Challenge Authentication | challenge_required |
| 12 | Challenge Authentication is Unavailable | challenge_required |
| 13 | Error on Authentication | authenticate_error |
| 14 | Data Only Successful (MC only: 5119737947565580) | data_only_successful |
| 15 | Authentication Unsuccessful | authenticate_rejected |
